name: claude-skills
description: S-Tier Staff Researcher — skills that help you operate at staff-researcher level. Proper workflows for polishing raw ideas, expressing them rigorously, and implementing them properly. Covers RPI (Research→Plan→Implement with Codex peer review), rigorous LaTeX authoring and review, paper refinement, TikZ/pgfplots figure cleanup, and pedagogical lecture enhancement.

plugins.name: rpi-workflow
plugins.description: Research → Plan → Implement workflow with Codex architectural peer review. Research the codebase with parallel Explore agents, write a plan, get an adversarial review from Codex, then implement. All artifacts land in docs/. The engineering flagship — refuses to vibe-code.

plugins.name: plan-to-dag
plugins.description: Convert large multistep plans into dependency-aware implementation DAGs with waves, parallel worksets, critical-path ownership, validation gates, and subagent prompt packs.

plugins.name: rigorous-paper-author
plugins.description: Develop and rehearse a scientific argument before extensive prose, then draft rigorous LaTeX with claim graphs, notation ledgers, proof obligations, and traceable evidence. Includes a slides-first paper-writing workflow.

plugins.name: rigorous-paper-reviewer
plugins.description: Deep 7-pass technical review of a LaTeX paper — structure, notation, theorem/proof, numerics, complexity, figures, coherence. Includes a static Python verifier for automated triage of labels, cross-references, and structure.

plugins.name: paper-discourse-graph
plugins.description: Connect a paper's opening question to its evidence, distinguish exposition gaps from missing results, and audit paragraph flow, reader prerequisites, and figure/equation placement before line editing.

plugins.name: refining-ml-papers
plugins.description: Revise scientific LaTeX papers from reviewer or advisor feedback with claim-level before/after comparisons, preserved rollback points, structural repairs, and rendered verification.

plugins.name: enhancing-latex-lectures
plugins.description: Feynman-test partner for lecture notes. Pattern-matches against exemplary pedagogical material (e.g. Todorov's PDFs) and adds stunning visualizations, concrete-to-abstract progressions, and insight boxes. Making a concept teachable is how you discover whether you understand it.

plugins.name: tikz-figure-review
plugins.description: Review and fix alignment, label collision, clipping, legend-over-data, and overlap issues in TikZ/pgfplots figures inside LaTeX documents. Covers 11 failure modes with canonical fixes plus an extract-standalone iteration loop.

plugins.name: animating-computational-mechanics
plugins.description: Animate continuum mechanics, tensor calculus, and FEM concepts — F on a unit circle, polar decomposition, Cauchy/PK1/PK2 tractions, weak form, mesh convergence — in Matplotlib, Manim, or Blender. Includes the ParaView → Stop-motion-OBJ → Blender pipeline. Distilled from Flaschel 2026 + the DrSimulate gallery.

plugins.name: explain-systems-visually
plugins.description: Teach technical systems through progressive reveals, stable semantic colors, and linked diagrams, equations, and algorithm steps. Rehearse an argument in slides before transferring it into a paper.

plugins.name: reader-comprehension-pass
plugins.description: Check what a first-time reader can explain from the visible document, locate missing prerequisites, and preserve scientific meaning while making technical writing easier to follow.
